description:
Bundles the index-wide default analyzer and per-column overrides used to build a SearchIndex. A SearchConfiguration is the equivalent of the analyzer wiring in the settings.analysis block of an OpenSearch create-index request — it points at the TextAnalyzer that supplies analysis.analyzer.default (and optionally analysis.analyzer.default_search) for the index, then layers any per-column overrides on top. Bind one to a project (or any entity) and every SearchIndex below it inherits the configuration.

Example using the system-bootstrapped SCIENTIFIC analyzer plus a column override:

{
  "organizationName": "biomed",
  "name": "publications_v1",
  "defaultAnalyzer": "org.sagebionetworks-SCIENTIFIC",
  "columnAnalyzerOverrides": ["biomed-publications_overrides"]
}

Asymmetric index/search analysis (e.g. edge_ngram autocomplete) is expressed inside the chosen TextAnalyzer's settings JSON by declaring both analyzer.default and analyzer.default_search; OpenSearch picks the right one per its search-analyzer precedence rules. There is no separate search-time analyzer field on the SearchConfiguration — in line with the OpenSearch docs' guidance that this case is uncommon.

Synonyms are not wired through the SearchConfiguration. A TextAnalyzer that wants synonyms references a SynonymSet directly via {"$ref": "{org}-{name}"} inside its own settings.filter registry map — see TextAnalyzer.

See SearchConfigBinding for how the configuration attaches to a project, TextAnalyzer / ColumnAnalyzerOverride for the analyzer components.

id.description: The unique ID of this search configuration.

organizationName.description: The name of the Organization this resource belongs to. Immutable after creation.

name.description: The resource name. Must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, and underscores. Unique within the organization and immutable after creation. Used as part of the qualified name ({organizationName}-{name}) when referenced by other resources.

defaultAnalyzer.description: Optional. Qualified name ('{organizationName}-{name}') of the TextAnalyzer that supplies this index's analysis.analyzer.default slot. If the same TextAnalyzer also declares an analyzer.default_search entry inside its settings, that becomes the index's analysis.analyzer.default_search — see OpenSearch's index analyzers and search analyzers for the precedence rules. If omitted, each column falls back to the system default analyzer for its data type (see ColumnTypeToOpenSearchMapping).

columnAnalyzerOverrides.description: Optional ordered list of ColumnAnalyzerOverride qualified names. Each one names per-column analyzer assignments; first match wins for duplicated column names across overrides.

etag.description: Synapse employs an Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) scheme.

createdOn.description: The date this resource was created.

createdBy.description: The ID of the user that created this resource.

modifiedOn.description: The date this resource was last modified.

modifiedBy.description: The ID of the user that last modified this resource.
